final: I was unable to remove Priya Sharma from #general. I identified her user ID (U_PRIYA) and the #general channel (C_GEN), confirmed she is a member, and attempted conversations.kick — but Slack returned the error "cant_kick_from_general". This is a built-in Slack API restriction: the #general channel is special-cased and the API does not allow kicking any user from it (all workspace members are inherently members of #general). No available API endpoint can override this, so the requested action is not possible via the Slack API.
